summary:
Backend-only verification of the KMS signer abstraction refactor for RoofSpan Control Plane. Ran existing pytest suites (test_control_plane.py, test_licensing_api.py, test_kms_signer.py, test_kms_issuance.py) => 37/37 passed. Additionally authored an INDEPENDENT live-URL suite (test_signer_refactor_live.py) that hits the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and asserts: (1) /api/control-plane/ready => {ready:true, db:true, signing_key:true, signer:'local'}, (2) POST /activate issues an EdDSA JWS that verifies with the published signing_public_keys and whose 'kid' is present in the key set, (3) POST /entitlement/refresh with Ed25519 request signing (reqsig headers X-RoofSpan-Installation/Timestamp/Nonce/Signature, canonical id
ts
nonce
sha256_hex(body)) returns a fresh JWS that verifies, (4) POST /signing-keys/rotate with X-RoofSpan-Admin produces a new active kid; old kid remains present in /signing-keys/public so previously-issued JWS still verifies, and a new activation is signed with the new active kid. All 4 live tests passed. Total: 41 tests, 41 passed. The refactor of _issue_entitlement to go through control_plane/signer.build_signer + licensing/entitlement.sign_entitlement_via_signer did not break live issuance; entitlements remain cryptographically verifiable with published Ed25519 public keys; rotation coexistence works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: control_plane/router.py::/signing-keys/public returns {"keys": {kid: pem}} while the review request text refers to 'signing_public_keys'. Not a bug, just a naming mismatch to be aware of when documenting the contract.

control_plane/service.py::_issue_entitlement correctly routes through cp_signer.build_signer(...) + ent.sign_entitlement_via_signer(...); good separation. In production the ENTITLEMENT_SIGNER=kms path is only unit-tested with mocked boto3 — recommend a staging smoke-test with a real KMS alias before first release.
seed_data_creation: Each activation test creates an ephemeral company (prefix TEST_co_) + installation with a freshly generated Ed25519 keypair; no cleanup required (unique UUID per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Live activation endpoint field name is 'installation_public_key' (NOT 'installation_public_key_pem'). /signing-keys/public returns {'keys': {kid: pem}}. Request signing headers are X-RoofSpan-Installation/Timestamp/Nonce/Signature; canonical message = installation_id
timestamp
nonce
sha256_hex(body); signature is standard base64 (not urlsafe). Signer mode surfaced at /api/control-plane/ready under 'signer' key; expect 'local' in this env, 'kms' in production. KMS path is validated via mocked-boto3 unit tests only in this container.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found; refactor verified working end-to-end via live HTTP against public URL.
